title: The Winter Solstice: The Longest Night, and the Light's Return

segments.text: On December twenty-first, the longest night of the year arrives. And then, the light comes back.
At the winter solstice, the Sun reaches its lowest point in the northern sky.
Five thousand years ago, Newgrange in Ireland was built so the solstice sunrise fills its inner chamber.
And Stonehenge frames the solstice sunset.
In astrology, this is the moment the Sun enters Capricorn, the sign of slow, steady building.

segments.title: LET GO
segments.text: Write down what you're leaving in the dark.

segments.title: LIGHT
segments.text: Light one candle for what you're calling in.

segments.title: REST
segments.text: Then rest. Seeds grow in the dark.
Save this for the twenty-first, and tell me what you're calling in.
